fields.description:
## Context

Test-writing sub-agents, the test-quality reviewer (d566-afa6), and the completion verifier (post-a03c-d55e) today have no canonical artifact that maps end-state intent items (SC/DoD/AC entries) to the tickets that own their test coverage. Concrete failure modes: duplicate test coverage emerges when parallel sprint sub-agents work against the same parent SC; orphan intent items (SCs no task ever covers) go undetected; the a03c-d55e pluggable validator hook has nothing to validate against when checking "does this end-state item have covering tests?". After this epic ships, when a sprint agent writes a test for SC2 the manifest validator will surface a duplicate-coverage warning at task closure; sprint orchestrators will see a distinct "Intent Allocation Findings" section in completion-verifier output where today they see silent pass-through.

Downstream consumer expectations:

- a03c-d55e provides a pluggable end-state-item-validator hook (contract_version=1; input {item_text, item_source_ticket_id, closure_timestamp}; output {valid, reason, severity: "block" or "warn"}). 94ed registers a manifest-aware default validator with this hook.
- d566-afa6 reads intent_id from the manifest to deduplicate test-quality reviewer suggestions; requires the stable slug-format intent_id this epic defines.
- 411b-a047 reads the manifest's intent_id-to-test_artifact mapping (manifest entry field `test_artifact.path`) to associate mutation findings with specific intent items.
- 7f42-e41f reads the manifest for per-intent-item growth metrics aggregation.
- 69e8-af39 mutates manifest entries to retroactively attribute production bug fixes back to intent items.

## Success Criteria

SC1: plugins/dso/docs/contracts/intent-allocation-manifest.md published. Per-entry schema: {intent_id (STABLE — slug or UUID; normative slug format `[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+){2,5}` derived deterministically from {epic_id_prefix, item_index, first_5_words_kebab_case}; never ordinal-derived; minted at item creation), owner_ticket (full ticket ID), test_artifact: {path: string, kind: "new"|"existing"}, deferred: bool (default false), lightweight: bool (default false; set by /dso:preplanning --lightweight when an item is not reassigned), shared_infra: optional epic-ID (explicit cross-epic owner_ticket sentinel), confidence: optional "high"|"medium"|"low" (assistant-emitted), rationale: optional string}. Manifest-level: contract_version=1. Tooling MUST preserve unknown entry fields in passthrough for forward-compatibility. Validator acceptance rule: entry is valid when intent_id matches the slug regex, owner_ticket resolves to a real ticket in the epic subtree (or shared_infra is set), and (kind="new" with path being a future path) OR (kind="existing" with the path file existing on disk).

SC2: /dso:brainstorm Phase 3 emits INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM: JSON ticket comment on the epic via plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-comment-from-file.sh (temp-file write to avoid ARG_MAX). Each end-state SC drafted gets an entry; intent_id minted by plugins/dso/scripts/intent-id-mint.sh from {epic_id, sc_index, first_5_words(sc_text)}; deferred=true; owner_ticket=epic-itself.

SC3: /dso:preplanning emits INTENT_ALLOCATION_PREPLANNING: JSON ticket comment on the parent epic (temp-file write). For each story DoD, mint stable intent_id. When reassigning an epic SC to a story, preserve the existing intent_id and set deferred=false. When running --lightweight, still emit the comment; unreassigned items get lightweight=true (default unset, only set in --lightweight mode) and deferred=true — this distinguishes intentional placeholders from genuine orphans.

SC4: /dso:implementation-plan emits INTENT_ALLOCATION_IMPLPLAN: JSON ticket comment on the parent story (temp-file write). For each task AC, mint stable intent_id. When reassigning a story DoD to a task, preserve intent_id and set deferred=false. test_artifact populated with the task's proposed test path (kind=new) OR an existing test path (kind=existing) for retroactive attribution.

SC5: plugins/dso/scripts/intent-allocation-read.sh <epic-id> walks the epic subtree, reads all INTENT_ALLOCATION_<STAGE>: comments, merges by stable intent_id. Stage precedence: brainstorm < preplanning < implementation-plan. Within-stage tiebreaker: most-recent timestamp. Same-stage same-timestamp tiebreaker: comment UUID lexical order (deterministic). _conflicts array surfaces equal-stage duplicates AND interleaved-stage anomalies (e.g., implementation-plan timestamp predates a late preplanning write). Output preserves unknown fields.

SC6: plugins/dso/scripts/intent-allocation-validate.sh <epic-id>. Finding types:
- orphan_intent: an intent_id present in any INTENT_ALLOCATION_<STAGE>: comment but with no resolved manifest entry after stage-precedence merge (seeded but never reassigned, never resolved by a downstream stage).
- unresolved_ambiguity: entry with merge-conflict that the merge rule could not resolve.
- stale_entry: entry whose intent_id no longer matches any current ticket text in the epic subtree.
- pending_intent: deferred=true; informational, non-blocking.
- lightweight_pending: lightweight=true; actionable, distinct from orphan; surfaces items that --lightweight preplanning explicitly flagged for follow-up.
- cross_epic_reference: owner_ticket resolves outside the epic subtree AND shared_infra field is unset.
Output supports --summary-mode flag for high-volume epics (groups findings by type with count-only output). Exit 0 on no actionable findings; non-zero with count when issues present.

SC7: a03c-d55e's pluggable end-state-item-validator hook is augmented with the manifest-aware default validator (registered when 94ed ships). Returns {valid: false, severity: "warn", reason: <finding_type>} for orphan_intent, unresolved_ambiguity, cross_epic_reference; {valid: true} for clean entries; ignores pending_intent and lightweight_pending (informational only). Falls back to a03c's basic default ("present and well-formed text") when the manifest is absent (legacy or pre-94ed tickets). The completion-verifier output template is updated to include a distinct "Intent Allocation Findings" section that surfaces warn-severity findings prominently (not buried in general output).

SC8: plugins/dso/agents/intent-allocation-assistant.md (opus-tier). Dispatched by /dso:preplanning and /dso:implementation-plan ONLY when count(unassigned-or-deferred intent items) > 0. Input: full decomposition tree as structured JSON (ticket IDs + types + scope summaries), unassigned intent items, parent's existing manifest entries. Output: per-item {intent_id, proposed_owner_ticket, proposed_test_artifact, rationale referencing specific ticket attributes (e.g., "task T3 owns AC-2 because T3's scope is the only one that touches the auth layer"), confidence: high|medium|low}. Confidence as ROUTING SIGNAL: high suggestions are pre-accepted (planner can reject any one); low suggestions are mandatory review (no batch-skip); medium suggestions follow per-item flow ("each suggestion presented individually; planner must explicitly accept, edit, or reject before the next is shown"). After all suggestions are presented, planner must identify 1-2 least-confident assignments (challenge round) before proceeding.

SC9: Cross-epic coordination with a03c-d55e. Three deliverables:
(i) a03c's haiku migration of brainstorm:complete-tagged epics is extended (in a03c's migration script) to ALSO emit INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM with deferred=true entries per item classified as end-state.
(ii) A ticket comment is posted to a03c-d55e-1393-4f27 referencing 94ed-f55c-51f5-45f6 and SC9, documenting the cross-epic dependency.
(iii) a03c-d55e's epic description is amended (via PR) to add a sub-bullet under its migration SC referencing the manifest backfill step.
Pass criterion: a fixture epic with 2 SCs in its description, post-a03c-migration, produces exactly 2 INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM entries with deferred=true and valid intent_ids matching the SC1 slug regex.

SC10: Synthetic end-to-end test covering three scenarios:
(a) HAPPY PATH: /dso:brainstorm dispatch produces 3-SC epic; INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM written with stable IDs + deferred=true. /dso:preplanning produces stories; INTENT_ALLOCATION_PREPLANNING extends manifest; SC entries reassigned with deferred=false. /dso:implementation-plan produces tasks; INTENT_ALLOCATION_IMPLPLAN extends manifest. read.sh returns merged manifest with zero _conflicts. validate.sh returns zero orphan_intent + zero lightweight_pending.
(b) PARALLEL-SPRINT DUPLICATE-DETECTION: simulate two sprint dispatches each registering a test_artifact entry against the same intent_id. BOTH signals must fire: validate.sh surfaces unresolved_ambiguity AND the test-quality reviewer (d566 integration once shipped, or a stand-in synthetic invocation) surfaces a dedup warning. Test pass requires both.
(c) ORPHAN-DETECTION: fixture epic with 1 SC and preplanning but no implementation-plan stage. With --lightweight preplanning the SC's manifest entry must have lightweight=true and deferred=true (default behavior of --lightweight, defined here). validate.sh surfaces lightweight_pending; completion-verifier dispatch produces a non-empty "Intent Allocation Findings" section naming the unresolved SC.

SC11: Assistant validation. Fixture preplanning dispatch with a 5-SC, 3-story epic triggers intent-allocation-assistant. Output includes at least one suggestion at each confidence tier (high, medium, low). Challenge round exercised (planner identifies 1-2 low-confidence items). Per-item acknowledge log records accept, edit, and reject paths at least once each.

## Approach

Five sequential phases, each independently mergeable:

- Phase 1: SC1 (contract) + SC2/SC3/SC4 (brainstorm/preplanning/implementation-plan emit INTENT_ALLOCATION_<STAGE>: comments) + stable-id helper.
- Phase 2: SC5 (read helper with stage-precedence + UUID tiebreaker) + SC6 (validate with 6 finding types + --summary-mode).
- Phase 3: SC7 (a03c hook integration + visible "Intent Allocation Findings" output section) + SC9 (cross-epic coordination — a03c migration backfill).
- Phase 4: SC8 (auto-population assistant with confidence-as-routing + challenge round) + SC11 (assistant validation).
- Phase 5: SC10 (three-scenario synthetic end-to-end test).

## Scenario Analysis (Blue Team surviving)

- Interleaved multi-stage writes break most-recent-wins (critical/correctness): partially mitigated by stage-precedence + UUID tiebreaker in SC5; residual risk in clock-skew across worktrees.
- Concurrent preplanning worktrees emit conflicting comments (critical/correctness): partially mitigated by _conflicts array surfacing in SC5; no automated resolution; manual reconciliation required.
- owner_ticket=epic sentinel never reassigned in --lightweight (high/correctness): mitigated by SC3 lightweight=true flag and SC6 lightweight_pending finding type (distinct from orphan).
- False test attribution: kind=existing path references a test that doesn't actually verify the intent (high/correctness): unmitigated; this is an LLM-judgment edge that no static check can resolve without semantic introspection of the test code.
- a03c hook warn severity silently masked (medium/observability): mitigated by SC7 distinct "Intent Allocation Findings" section in completion-verifier output.
- Assistant proposes owner=current-task generically (medium/adoption): partially mitigated by SC8 decomposition-tree-as-structured-input + rationale-must-reference-specific-ticket-attribute requirement.
- Cross-epic owner_ticket reference (medium/correctness): mitigated by SC1 shared_infra field + SC6 cross_epic_reference finding type.
- Per-item acknowledge UI fatigue (medium/adoption): partially mitigated by SC8 confidence-as-routing (high pre-accepted, low mandatory) + challenge round; residual risk on medium-tier volume.
- Epic closure leaves manifest entries as permanent orphans (medium/correctness): unmitigated; deferred to ticket-system observability work outside this epic's scope.
- Equal-timestamp merge non-deterministic (low/correctness): mitigated by SC5 UUID tiebreaker.

## Research Findings

Cross-stream synthesis from d566-afa6's brainstorm research dispatches identified intent-claim articulation (Tier 2) as the strongest LLM-friendly catch-power signal. This epic delivers the manifest infrastructure that the Tier 2 articulation references — without a stable shared intent_id vocabulary, Tier 2 claims devolve into free-text drift.

## Dependencies

- a03c-d55e (Closure Checks schema migration) — required. Provides the end-state SC/DoD/AC separation that this epic's intent_id format references; provides the pluggable end-state-item-validator hook that SC7 registers a manifest-aware validator with.

Implicit downstream coupling: this epic amends d566-afa6's Rule 6 (in behavioral-testing-standard.md) to use stable slug-format intent_id rather than ordinal references (SC-1, DoD-2.a). Recoverable since d566 has not yet been preplanned or implemented. The amendment is recorded as a ticket comment on d566.

## Planning Intelligence Log

- Web research (Step 2): not triggered. Sufficient context inherited from d566 brainstorm research dispatches.
- Scenario analysis (Step 3): triggered (SCs >= 5); 16 red-team scenarios surfaced; 10 surviving after blue-team filter.
- Cross-epic scan (Step 2.25): 1 conflict (a03c, intentional hook coupling), 1 ambiguity (d566 intent_id vocabulary resolved via Dependencies amendment note), 3 considerations (411b/7f42/69e8 downstream consumers), 2 benign.
- Bot-psychologist (Step 5): triggered (LLM-instruction signal — modifies brainstorm/preplanning/implementation-plan skills + new opus assistant agent). Five risks identified; all folded into SC1 (stable intent_id), SC2 (deferred flag default), SC8 (confidence-as-routing, challenge round, structured decomposition tree), SC6 (lightweight_pending finding type).
- Fidelity review (Step 4): Agent Clarity (4, 4), Scope (4, 5, 4, 4), Value (5, 5). All dimensions >= 4.
- Scale context (Step 0): small — per-epic artifact, dozens of entries max per manifest. Not volume-sensitive at runtime.
- Session-signal override for complexity routing: success_criteria_count = 11 (>= 7 threshold) — would route to /dso:preplanning full mode if invoked; preplanning explicitly deferred this session.
- User-directed scope additions: ship all three approach options (A + B + C) — minimal infrastructure + validation tool + auto-population assistant.
